limitations: This is the latest official snapshot successfully read in this planning pass, not a certification that no newer study exists.
Issues overlap; multi-response percentages do not sum to 100. Do not sum employment and unemployment percentages as if they were disjoint.
CIS concern categories do not uniquely map to programme questions. The final ordering is explicitly editorial.

Migration is salient but has no directly authored question in the current 80-question bank. Reopen applicable full source contexts and directly author a supported decision before representing it; never substitute an unrelated rights question.
Current concern data only orders the historical 2023 edition; it never updates 2023 political positions.

verification.downloadAndExtraction: Official PDFs downloaded via urllib using bundled Python/pypdf after web fetch returned 403; byte signatures and SHA-256 verified.
verification.visualInspection: Both full relevant table pages rendered with pdftoppm and inspected at 1400px; row labels, TOTAL columns and footers agree with extraction.
